mapper.insert: INSERT INTO punch_photo_cleanup_jobs (path, user_id, attempts, next_attempt_at) VALUES (#{path}, #{userId}, 0, #{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE next_attempt_at = VALUES(next_attempt_at)
mapper.select: SELECT path, user_id AS userId, attempts, lease_until AS leaseUntil FROM punch_photo_cleanup_jobs WHERE next_attempt_at <= #{now} AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until <= #{now}) ORDER BY next_attempt_at LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM punch_photo_cleanup_jobs WHERE path = #{path} AND lease_until = #{leaseUntil}
